Name: Constant steer-angle cornering test
Notes: Consumed by cornering.py. After stationary settling and a straight run-in at the target speed, the front wheel is steered to Steering_angle_deg (positive = left turn) with a smooth ramp and held. A PI controller drives Drive_wheels (equal torque split, i.e. an open differential) to hold the target speed, as assumed by Rodriguez Licea et al. (2018).
